definitions.explanation: A place of Buddhist worship, distinct from Shinto shrines.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}には{古|ふる}い{寺|てら}がたくさんあります。
examples.english: There are many old temples in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: お{寺|てら}で{座禅|ざぜん}を{体験|たいけん}しました。
examples.english: I experienced Zen meditation at the temple.

examples.japanese: お{盆|ぼん}にお{寺|てら}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to the temple during Obon.

notes:
{寺|てら} (also お{寺|てら}) is a Buddhist temple, distinct from {神社|じんじゃ} (Shinto shrine).

TEMPLE vs SHRINE:
- {寺|てら}/{寺院|じいん}: Buddhist temple
- {神社|じんじゃ}: Shinto shrine

FAMOUS TEMPLES:
- {金閣寺|きんかくじ}: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
- {清水寺|きよみずでら}: Kiyomizu-dera
- {東大寺|とうだいじ}: Todai-ji
- {浅草寺|せんそうじ}: Senso-ji

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{寺|てら}に{参|まい}る: to visit a temple
- {寺|てら}{院|いん}: temple (formal)
- 〜{寺|じ}/〜{寺|てら}: temple name suffix
